title: Commitment
description: A commitment record: a promise an organisation has made about what it will or will not do, with the structure a reader needs to check whether the promise can be verified.

statement.description: the prose text of the commitment as it was published

committed_at.description: ISO-8601 date the commitment was first made

last_reviewed_at.description: ISO-8601 date of the most recent public review

derived_from.description: the publicly-cited principle or policy the commitment implements

trigger.description: the condition under which the commitment applies or activates

metric.description: a named measurable, or a reference to one

threshold.description: the value or interval at which the trigger fires

enforcer.description: who or what checks and enforces this commitment

dependencies.description: external facts or systems whose change would invalidate or alter this commitment

escape_clauses.description: exemptions or conditions under which the commitment does not bind

scope.description: the specific trigger-metric this clause narrows; broader than that is a scope-expansion

target_metric.description: for kind=target: the measurable the organisation commits to

target_deadline.description: for kind=target: the deadline by which the metric is to be met

externally_verifiable.description: whether a reader outside the organisation can confirm compliance
